section.content: The present invention provides a semiconductor integrated circuit device comprising a main memory portion, a sub memory portion composed of a plurality of memory cell groups and a bi-directional data transfer circuit provided between the main memory device and said sub memory portion, wherein a bi-directional data transfer between an arbitrary area of said main memory portion and the plurality of the memory cell groups and a read or write operation are performed simultaneously. Therefore, the semiconductor integrated circuit device of the present invention has a main memory suitable for being accessed from a plurality of data processors.
